_comment: AZ1 map nodes that SceneData splits into faction variants (issue #34). The client prefab campaign/az01/nodes has only the canonical node (Node023, Node026) and its paths; the variants (Node023A/B, Node026A/B) are not map nodes. The server sends one location on the canonical node; 'by_faction' names the variant whose SceneData text and NODE scene the champion's faction plays. The client data has no explicit link, so the mapping follows the authored content: the Node 23 ARDENT intro and its Success texts are about the necrotic (023B 'a group of necrotic ... overwhelmed', scenes 23B/23B_2 NECROTIC), the UNDERWORLD ones about the humans (023A, scenes 23A/23A_2 HUMANS); the Node 26 'Ardent player' conversations name the Brood Creeper (the AI champion of scene 26B WAYWARD VENNEN, SceneData 026B), the 'Underworld player' ones the Furious Taskmaster (the AI champion of scene 26 WAYWARD ORCS, SceneData 026A). A variant without its own scene falls back to the canonical NODE scene (026A -> NODE 26). 'choices' maps an intro answer's ServerScriptEvent (sent as a campaign sendevent) to the battle scene suffix (23B + '_2' -> NODE 23B_2 ... NO HELP) and to the label of the matching Success conversation; 'default_choice' applies until an answer was recorded.
_comment_faction_battles: Issue #38: The Burk Heart (45) and Eagle Mesa (75) play a faction battle after their dialogue. The scenes are lettered (NODE 45A/45B, NODE 75 A/B) and have no SceneData item of their own. The faction follows the AI champion and the node's dialogues: Ardent fights the Necrophage Sensei (45A) and the Elimination Specialist (75 A, 'Ardent battle (Elimination Specialist)'), Underworld the Ashwood Maestro (45B) and the Earthcaller (75 B); confirmed on video by the HEX Revival notes (MHS Ardent/UW, Vandersveldt part 37).
_comment_gate: Issue #38: a 'gate' node closes its neighbours (Brink Ridge: Node021/Node023/Node077) until PublicState.Data[flag] is set. While closed the node plays 'conversation' (the guard's 'Blockade - Step 2'). Its answers are 'choices' (ServerScriptEvents): 'battle' names the scene fought after the dialogue (NODE 19A, Human Guard; winning sets the flag), 'clears' sets the flag at once (sneak past), 'cost_gold' is paid at the answer and the answer is refused when the gold is missing (the 1,000 gold bribe; the client also requires it). 'after_dungeon' is a one-time battle on the node once the named dungeon is finished (NODE 19B1 Barricade Zombie after The Smoldering Dead, PH:22).
_comment_escorts: Issue #38 fix 10: Gnomes Come Home. An 'escort' is a quest whose party travels with the champion across the map (HEX Revival Gnomes.cs, video: Vandersveldt parts 41-54, MyHotStream Underworld 2016-10-30). The QuestTemplate gives 'quest', the two QuestObjectiveCollect counters ('carried': Step2_INFO 'Current gnomes', m_PublicScriptVar 'carry'; 'delivered': Step2 'Get all gnomes safely back to the south camp', m_PublicScriptVar 'count', m_CountRequired 20 = 'total') and 'found' (Step1, completed by Herbert's 'Lost Gnomes - Step 1'). Both counters live in the QUEST state's PublicState.Data under their script vars, which the client's quest tracker reads. 'picker': after the node's dialogue, while the party is found, none in tow and some still waiting, the node becomes the client's CountPicker ('Select Number of Gnomes', 0..waiting) and answers count_choice; the bounds are PublicState.Data vars of the AREA state. 'deliver': closing one of these conversations at the node brings the party in tow home; once all are home the collect objectives complete and the quest moves to its turn-in. 'routes' are hidden while no one is in tow (until all are home); 'battles' are fought only with a party in tow, re-armed for every trip (each pick reopens them), and stay one-time battles once all are home; without a party they play their node dialogue. 'deck_cards' are added to the champion's deck in those battles: 'count' copies per 'per' carried (one Lost Gnome per gnome, 2 Primal Shards per 3: the picker's text).
